visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark bangs and a fuzzy bear-ear headband lies on a bed with white linens featuring small brown bear patterns. Her face is in a soft close-up, and she gazes warmly at the camera with gentle lighting. (2) The scene shifts to the woman in a white button-down shirt standing by a sun-drenched window. The bright backlighting creates a silhouette effect as she looks out at a snowy city street and then turns her face to smile brightly at the viewer. (3) In an indoor setting, she wears white bear-print pajamas and sits on a bed with a white instant camera and bear plushie. She holds a small yellow bottle, her hands showing delicate movements, and then she lies back, posing with a peace sign over her face. (4) Transitioning outdoors, she walks through a path of snow-covered red torii gates. She is dressed in a red hooded knit cap, blue floral-patterned sweater, and white skirt. She turns back, smiling joyfully, with the winter forest and snow as a scenic background. (5) In a park area filled with snow and brown fallen leaves, she wears a white fuzzy sweater and an orange beanie. She crouches down while holding her yellow bottle and then rolls playfully onto the snowy ground, her hands touching her face in laughter. (6) Wearing a red sports bra and an unbuttoned striped shirt, she sits directly in the cold snow. She smiles and playfully tosses a handful of snow towards the lens against a rustic wooden wall background in the soft winter light. (7) She is seen running through a deep snowy field bordered by tall, bare winter trees under a clear sky. She stops to look at the camera, placing a hand against her cheek and smiling broadly as the camera captures her full body. (8) The final phase consists of a static black screen with elegant white text overlays providing details about the product. There are no characters or objects present in this minimalist graphic environment, which uses flat, high-contrast digital lighting.
